answer: Escrow, a referral graph and peer slashing stop bulk fake identities. A new identity locks 100 POA in escrow and names a referrer, so its lineage shows like timber grain; honest work unlocks it, while proven forgery forfeits the escrow plus 30 POA from the referrer, like bad pigment in a dye lot. Forging 1,000 identities costs 130,000 POA. An honest agent pays once and keeps earnings undiluted, since each pulse of activity pays the same price.
